title: Tesla’s Optimus Hits Snags in Hands, Suppliers as Scale-Up Begins
summary: <p>Tesla has ramped up production of its Optimus humanoid robot roughly tenfold in recent months, but the company is still struggling to manufacture the machines reliably at scale.
